annotations.title: Pick at random from a list

description: Pick one or more items at random (without repeats) from a comma- or line-separated list. Use for raffles, choosing who goes first, or breaking ties fairly. Example: items=Ada,Alan,Grace,Linus. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: random_pick
title: Pick at random from a list
